==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{l|en|myddle}} {{qualifier|obsolete}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:myddel|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|myddel}}, {{m|enm|middel}}, from {{inh|en|ang|middel||middle, centre, waist}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*midlą}}, {{m|gem-pro|*midilą}}, {{m|gem-pro|*medalą||middle}}, a diminutive of {{der|en|gem-pro|*midjō||middle, midst}} (compare {{m|gem-pro|*midjaz||mid, middle|pos=adjective}}), from {{der|en|ine-pro|*médʰyos||between, in the middle, middle}}. 
{{col-top|2|cog}}
Cognate with {{cog|stq|Middel||middle}}, {{cog|fy|mul||middle}}, {{cog|nl|middel||means; medicine, cure}}, {{cog|de|mittel||middle|pos=adjective}}, {{m|de|Mittel||means; medicament, remedy|pos=noun}}, {{cog|lb|Mëttel||means, method; medicament}}, {{cog|wym|mytuł||middle}}, {{cog|yi|מיטל||middle}}, {{cog|da|-}}, {{cog|nb|-}} and {{cog|nn|middel||means}}, {{cog|is|meðal||average; means, medicine}}, {{cog|sv|medel||average, mean, middle}}. See also {{l|en|mid}}.
{{col-bottom}}

===Pronunciation===

* {{IPA|en|/ˈmɪdl̩/|[ˈmɪ.ɾɫ̩]|a=US}}

* {{IPA|en|/ˈmɪdəl/|[ˈmɪ̝.dəɫ]|[ˈmɪ̝.dʊ]|[ˈmɪ̝.ɾ-]|a=AU}}
* {{audio|en|en-au-middle.ogg|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈmɘdɘl/|[ˈmə.dɯ(ɫ)]|[ˈmə.ɾ-]|a=NZ}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪdəl|s=2}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[centre]], [[midpoint]].
#: {{ux|en|The '''middle''' of a circle is the point which has the same distance to every point of circle.}}
# The part between the beginning and the end.
#: {{ux|en|I woke up in the '''middle''' of the night.}}
#: {{ux|en|In the '''middle''' of the marathon, David collapsed from fatigue.}}
#* {{RQ:Lincoln Pratt's Patients|chapter=1|passage=Then there came a reg'lar terror of a sou'wester same as you don't get one summer in a thousand, and blowed the shanty flat and ripped about half of the weir poles out of the sand. We spent consider'ble money getting 'em reset, and then a swordfish got into the pound and tore the nets all to slathers, right in the '''middle''' of the squiteague season.}}
# {{lb|en|cricket}} The [[middle stump]].
# The central part of a human body; the [[waist]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2012|author=Caroline Moore|title=Fasting In A Fast World
|passage=If I have a diet plan and stick to it, it is easy for me to have control over my '''middle'''.}}
# {{lb|en|grammar}} The [[middle voice]].
# {{lb|en|politics}} the center of the [[political spectrum]].
#: {{ux|en|As part of his successful re-election strategy, Clinton began governing from the '''middle'''.}}
# An [[essay]] on social or literary issues in a [[newspaper]] or [[magazine]], originally placed between the leading articles and the reviews.
#* {{RQ:Kipling Diversity of Creatures|story=The Village that Voted the Earth was Flat|page=171|passage=‘Did you see the ''Spec.'' had a '''middle''' on “Rural Tenacities” last week. That was all Huckley.’}}
# {{lb|en|card games}} A card dealt [[surreptitiously]] from the middle of the [[deck]], instead of from the [[top]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1955|year_published=1959|author=w:Ian Fleming|title={{w|Moonraker (novel)|Moonraker}}|volume=|location=London|publisher=Pan Books|chapter=‘Belly Strippers’, etc.|page=20|passage=Bond smiled grimly. "Steffi Esposito," he said softly. "That was the chap. American. Made me work ten hours a day for a week learning a thing called the Riffle Stack and how to deal Seconds and Bottoms and '''Middles'''."}}
